title: Portable Artifacts
subtitle: What this branch builds, how to use it, and what it is worth, with working samples.

sections.title: One JSON file becomes a page or video
sections.label: At a glance
sections.text: This branch adds four agent skills that build offline dashboards, diagrams, explainer pages and short videos. The model writes only a small JSON file, and scripts validate, lay out and render it.
points: make-dashboard v2 builds live, offline dashboards from local data files.
make-diagram, make-explainer and make-motion add diagrams, pages and videos from JSON.
Every page makes no network requests and carries a strict Content Security Policy.

sections.title: Four skills share one JSON-to-page loop
sections.label: Four skills

items.title: make-dashboard v2
items.text: Builds one offline dashboard from CSV, Parquet, JSON, DuckDB or SQLite files. Its charts sort, compare and export, and the page reloads when the spec changes.

items.title: make-diagram
items.text: Draws architecture, flow, sequence and state diagrams from a small JSON topology. Layout is computed at build time, so the model never writes coordinates.

items.title: make-explainer
items.text: Builds one themed page or slide deck from typed sections. It can embed diagrams, charts and videos made by the other skills.

items.title: make-motion
items.text: Renders a short MP4 video from a JSON list of scenes. Text, shapes, counters and transitions are all set in the file.

sections.title: A request passes validate and build
sections.label: Request flow
sections.caption: The agent fills in the JSON spec, and scripts check and render it. The embedded skills supply figures, charts and videos.

sections.title: Install once, then ask in plain words
sections.label: Getting started

items.title: Install the skills
items.text: Run one of the install commands in the next section. The skills are added to your agent.

items.title: Ask for a page
items.text: Describe what to explain in plain words, or call the skill directly with a slash command.

items.title: Validate the JSON
items.text: The skill runs validate.mjs. Each problem prints a JSON path, the problem and the fix. The agent reruns it until the output says valid.

items.title: Build the page
items.text: The skill runs build.mjs, which writes one offline HTML page and prints its path. Open that file in any browser.

items.title: Check the page (optional)
items.text: Run check.mjs on the page. It looks for console errors and sideways scrolling at desktop and phone width.

sections.title: Two install routes cover Claude Code and others
sections.label: Install
sections.caption: The first two lines install in Claude Code. The third line installs with npx for any agent. The last two lines use the bundled installer.
sections.code:
/plugin marketplace add abhijitbansal/claude-skills
/plugin install portable-artifacts@claude-skills
npx skills add abhijitbansal/claude-skills --skill make-explainer make-diagram make-dashboard
git clone https://github.com/abhijitbansal/claude-skills
node claude-skills/plugins/portable-artifacts/bin/install.mjs codex

sections.title: Four slash commands each produce a different page
sections.label: Commands
rows: /make-explainer recap of this branch with a test checklist
One offline page that recaps the branch and lists the manual tests.
/make-diagram architecture of the checkout service with its database and queue
One offline diagram of the services, with icons and zoom.
/make-dashboard revenue by region and monthly trend from data/sales.csv
One offline dashboard built from the CSV file, with sortable tables and export.
/make-motion a 6 second title card that counts up to 18
One short MP4 video with a title card that counts up to 18.
sections.caption: Each request is one sentence. The skill fills in its own JSON file and builds the output.

sections.title: Spec-driven pages cost less and stay consistent
sections.label: Versus hand-written

columns.title: Hand-written AI pages
points: The model writes the HTML, CSS and script for every page, which costs more output.
Each run can produce a different look, and it often has the generic look of an AI page.
A small change can disturb the rest of the page.

columns.title: Spec-driven pages
points: The model writes only JSON, so the cheapest model passes the eval gates.
The same spec always gives the same page, and a change is one edited field.
Validation names the JSON path and the fix, so most errors are repaired in one or two runs.

sections.verdict: A spec keeps the cost low and the output the same from run to run.

sections.title: Five known limits each have a clear workaround
sections.label: Known limits

items.risk: An interactive chart needs a make-dashboard spec. Inline rows give a static chart only.
items.mitigation: Use a make-dashboard spec when the reader needs the interactive views.

items.risk: Explainer charts refuse Postgres and MySQL sources, so builds never reach the network.
items.mitigation: Export the data to CSV or Parquet first.

items.risk: In a slide deck, browser find (Ctrl-F) searches only the current slide.
items.mitigation: Use page mode when the reader needs to search the whole text.

items.risk: Each static chart ships four drawings, which adds weight to long pages.
items.mitigation: Keep long pages to a few charts.

items.risk: make-motion was not re-evaluated on this branch, so it is not pinned to a model.
items.mitigation: Check each video by hand before sharing it.

sections.title: CI is green; eval-gated skills pass with Haiku
sections.text: CI on PR #38 passes 5 of 5 checks. make-dashboard v2, make-diagram and make-explainer each passed their Haiku eval gate. make-motion has no eval gate yet.
